summary_en: This Phase 3 study compares JNJ-79635322 with teclistamab in adults with relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma who have had 1 to 3 prior lines of therapy, including an anti-CD38 antibody and lenalidomide. Both drugs are given as subcutaneous injections; JNJ-79635322 is given for a finite duration or until intolerable toxicity, whichever comes first, and teclistamab is given until progressive disease or intolerable toxicity. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is Phase 3.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 3 compara JNJ-79635322 con teclistamab en adultos con mieloma múltiple recidivante o refractario que han recibido de 1 a 3 líneas previas de tratamiento, incluido un anticuerpo anti-CD38 y lenalidomida. Ambos medicamentos se administran como inyecciones subcutáneas; JNJ-79635322 se administra por una duración finita o hasta toxicidad intolerable, lo que ocurra primero, y teclistamab se administra hasta progresión de la enfermedad o toxicidad intolerable. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de Fase 3.
who_for: Diagnosed with multiple myeloma by IMWG criteria, with measurable disease at screening
Received 1 to 3 prior antimyeloma therapy lines, including an anti-CD38 antibody and lenalidomide
ECOG performance status of 0 to 2 at screening and before the first dose
Clinical laboratory values meeting protocol criteria during screening and within 1 day of treatment start
not_for: Major surgery or significant traumatic injury within 2 weeks before first dose, or planned surgery during the study
Allergy or hypersensitivity to JNJ-79635322, teclistamab, or their excipients
Ongoing myelodysplastic syndrome or a B-cell malignancy other than myeloma
Other malignancy at high risk of recurrence needing systemic therapy, or other active malignancy in the last 24 months
Known active or prior central nervous system involvement or signs of meningeal myeloma
